relations.subject: Sonam Rinchen
relations.evidence: entered the monastic university of Sera in Lhasa in 1952, where he studied until he was forced to flee Tibet in 1959.

relations.subject: Sonam Rinchen
relations.object: Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies
relations.evidence: He also received the degree of Acarya from the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies in Sarnath.

relations.subject: Sonam Rinchen
relations.object: Library of Tibetan Works and Archives
relations.evidence: He was appointed resident teacher at the Library of Tibetan Works and Archives in Dharamshala, India in 1978
